NC-003.reason: execPowerShell spawns the PowerShell executable directly with an argv (-NoProfile -NonInteractive -EncodedCommand <utf16le base64>) through runCommand; there is no cmd.exe string joining or quoting, so PowerShell 7 paths with spaces and commands containing double quotes work.

NC-004.reason: runCommand returns {success, code, stdout, stderr} from the exit status, and execCmd returns '' on any non-zero exit (the failure-word heuristic is gone); package_manager checks exit status and the installed marker.

NC-012.reason: package_manager.remove uses a per-manager remove command (pmanager_map) and returns false on failure; purge/autoremove/clean check results.

NC-017.reason: winget.configureSource verifies the source list before persisting 'configured' and resets on failure (per the owner report; the diff follows the finding's fix).

NC-018.reason: Async results keep stderr as the error (no stdout overwrite).

NC-019.reason: edge-tts is spawned with an argv array and its success is checked, so text containing quotes, $(...) or %VAR% cannot break out.

NC-029.reason: spawnAsync clears its idle timer on finish (close/error), so no callback fires after exit; pipeExecCmdAsync maps its arguments explicitly.

NC-031.reason: VideoCompressor checks result.success and passes stderr (ffmpeg's progress stream) to the progress callback.

NC-032.reason: No process.chdir remains in commander.js, cmder.js or porttool.js; options.cwd is used. The dead copies with chdir are left for ncore-6 deletion.
